budget.stage: Callback admission and copy, per record
budget.requirement: p99 under 50 µs (R9, R11). Stated in nanoseconds so a bucket bound can be compared exactly.

budgets.evidence: Busiest level 'disk-bound'. The bucket's upper bound is compared, so a met budget is met by the whole bucket. Series 'capture-comparison-20260922T234102Z-series-stacks'.

budget.requirement: No unpooled allocation on the callback path (R9, R11). Measured as the slope of admission's allocation against records admitted, so a fixed setup cost is not read as a per-record one. One byte per record is the resolution at which a slope tells growth from noise; the adapter's own allocation is a separate quantity and is never added to this one (ADR-009).

budgets.evidence: Fitted across levels 'paced' and 'peak': 1 616 bytes over 1 078 records against 1 680 bytes over 146 785. About 1 616 bytes of that does not grow with the record count. Both runs replay the same evidence through the same adapter, once with the admission table and once with none, so what is left is admission's own cost. Series 'capture-comparison-20260922T234102Z-series-stacks'.
